author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.7.3 — The workStatusCode attribute added in 1.7.2 hasn't reliably shown up in the device UI after driver updates for one user. Adds a log.info line in handleVacuumStatusResponse logging the raw vacuum_work_status code alongside the translated status label on every poll, as a more reliable way to get real numbers for checking the unverified status label mapping.
